title: I'm not a game developer (I'm a doctor..). AI helped me build and release my first game in a month.
author: ConcernedParsnip
selftext:
I've dabbled in coding for years, but never had the skills (or frankly the time) to build and release a complete game. (make sure sound is on, the music is jaunty...)

AI has hugely lowered the barrier for idea to reality and the result is The Inkline!  I've also churned out a couple of other prototypes of similar paper based games, a platformer, folding puzzle game, turn based wars all of which I might run with but one thing at a time...!!

It's a physics-based game where you draw the ground beneath a little ink blob to keep him alive. There's a campaign, daily challenges, a level editor and then I had to stop because I started rebuilding the game into something it wasn't supposed to be!

An early version got 3,000 plays in 48 hours from one Reddit post, this seemed nuts so I ran with it, but struggling to reach that traction again!

Something veery similar appeared 2 days after mine in itch (also called Inkline...) and is trying to sell it for £2 which I guess is a compliment or coincidence I don't know - or will just happen with ai dev

The refining process has been sorting the physics, designing levels and trying to make the whole thing feel like a proper game rather than a  AI prototype.  Every crazy idea was able to be tried which is nuts..

It's now on the App Store and on itch... I'm not going to be able to retire on the proceeds but it's been a fun ride

Feedback very welcome!!

Demo : [https://theinkline.web.app/](https://theinkline.web.app/)

Itch : [https://inklinestudios.itch.io/the-inkline](https://inklinestudios.itch.io/the-inkline)
